facts.fact: The Federal Government says it launched the nationwide Learner Identification Number, and that over 1.9 million candidates registered for the 2026 WAEC and NECO examinations have been issued one in the first phase, building on DNEMIS.

systems.system: Digitized National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)

note: as_of is the document's published date; it gives no launch date.
